info.title: API.SH: Tennis Abstract
info.description: The Tennis Abstract API from API.SH: public Tennis Abstract data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Shot-by-shot statistics of one charted match: serve basics and breakdowns by court and direction, return depth and outcomes, key points (break points, game points), rally outcomes by length, stats overview, shot types and directions, net points and serve influence, per player. `include=pointlog` adds the point-by-point log.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisabstract-charting-match

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Charted match id (from `chart_id` in /tennisabstract/v1/matches) or its tennisabstract.com/charting/ link.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: pointlog: also return the point-by-point log.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: 2023 Roland Garros F: Casper Ruud vs Novak Djokovic

get.description:
A player's Match Charting Project page: serve, return, key points, rally outcomes, shot types and directions and net play across all of the player's charted matches.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisabstract-charting-player

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player name, slug or tennisabstract.com link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Tennis Abstract's weekly Elo ratings for the ATP or WTA: overall Elo, hard, clay and grass Elo with their ranks, peak Elo and month, age and official rank, for every player with 10+ recent matches. `season=true` gives the current season's yElo list (wins, losses, yElo). Sort by any surface, filter by player name. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisabstract-elo

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: true: the current season's yElo ratings instead of overall Elo.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only players whose name contains this.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Tennis Abstract tournament forecast and results
get.description:
A tournament's page: each player's chance (%) of reaching every remaining round, with seed and country, completed and upcoming singles and doubles matches (round, players, score, head-to-head), and earlier forecasts when the page keeps them. Event ids look like 2025ATPParis or 2025WimbledonMenForecast; the site keeps pages for current and recent events.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisabstract-forecast

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Event id from a tennisabstract.com/current/ link, or the link itself.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every tour-level, Challenger and ITF singles match of a player (ATP: the whole career; WTA: the last two seasons, older seasons with `career=true` or an older `year`), newest first: date, tournament, surface, level, round, result, score, ranks and seeds, the opponent (rank, hand, height, country) and both players' serve stats (aces, double faults, serve points, first serves in and won, second serves won, service games, break points saved and faced). Filters by year, surface, level, result, opponent and tournament. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisabstract-matches

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player name, slug or tennisabstract.com player link.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Only wins, losses or scheduled matches.

parameters.name: career
parameters.description: WTA: include seasons before the last two.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Tennis Abstract player profile and stats
get.description:
A player's profile (country, birth date, height, plays, backhand, current and peak ranking, Elo rating and rank, ids) plus every table of the player's page: recent results with serve and return stats, tour and Challenger seasons, titles and finals, year-end rankings, career and last-52-weeks splits, winners and unforced errors, serve speed, key points and games, Match Charting Project serve/return/rally/tactics summaries and frequent head-to-heads. `sections` picks some of them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisabstract-player

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player name, slug (CarlosAlcaraz) or tennisabstract.com player link.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Comma-separated section ids to return (e.g. recent-results,career-splits); default all. `available_sections` lists them.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Find ATP and WTA players by name across the site's full player list (current and historical players). Each hit has the name, tour and the player slug the other Tennis Abstract endpoints accept. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisabstract-players

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a player name (accents optional).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One of Tennis Abstract's weekly reports as rows: full ATP/WTA rankings with birth dates, rankings by country, left-handers, one-handed backhands, rankings by age group, ranking milestones, next Grand Slam forecast, bagels and breadsticks (bakery), lottery matches, the best players who haven't reached a milestone, surface speed by event, top-player head-to-head matrix, today's birthdays, and Match Charting Project leaders for serve, return, rally, tactics and winners/errors (last 52 weeks or career). Reports with several lists return the first under `rows` and the rest under `other_tables`. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tennisabstract-report

parameters.name: span
parameters.description: Match Charting Project and winners/errors reports: last 52 weeks (default) or career.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only rows mentioning this text (e.g. a player or country).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: 2026 ATP and ITF Rankings
example.description: A simple ranking report sortable by country and date of birth.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
